THREE DOORS / ONE QUICK DECISION

West Bank: Frontier Edition

Gold fever is somebody else’s problem. Your job is to protect the deposits—and make sure the honest customers get home.

← Back to the field tripOpen original view ↗

How to play & a few field notes +

Press 1, 2 or 3 to fire at the left, middle or right door, or tap the door or its fire button. Use O / P or the left / right arrows to move between bank sections, only when all doors are shut. Escape pauses, and M toggles sound.

Let customers deposit their gold. Shoot only a raised pistol: some enemies arrive armed, while others wait to draw. From shift two, shoot off the hat man’s five hats; shoot any gold beneath, but leave a bomb alone. Fund all nine doors, then survive three duellists to earn $500 and a life.

Two days, eighteen shifts, three difficulty levels, five lives maximum. An independent tribute to Dinamic Software’s West Bank, using new code, art and sound. Arcade fiction, with no claim to historical authenticity.
